name: Metformin + Vildagliptin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: One tablet (vildagliptin 50 mg with metformin hydrochloride 850 mg or 1,000 mg) twice daily with or just after meals; maximum vildagliptin 100 mg/day

key_interactions.effect: Contrast-related kidney injury can cause metformin accumulation and lactic acidosis.
key_interactions.action: Stop before or at the time of imaging; restart after 48 hours once kidney function is stable.

key_interactions.effect: Raises lactic acidosis risk, especially when intoxicated.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: NSAIDs, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, diuretics (especially loop diuretics)
key_interactions.effect: May impair kidney function and raise lactic acidosis risk.
key_interactions.action: Use with caution; monitor kidney function closely.

common: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, flatulence, reflux
serious: Vitamin B12 deficiency with long-term use
Bullous or exfoliative skin lesions, bullous pemphigoid

contraindications: Acute metabolic acidosis (lactic acidosis, diabetic ketoacidosis); diabetic precoma
Acute conditions that can alter kidney function: dehydration, severe infection, shock, intravascular iodinated contrast
Conditions causing tissue hypoxia: heart or respiratory failure, recent myocardial infarction, shock
monitoring: GFR at baseline and at least yearly (every 3 to 6 months if older or at risk)
Liver function tests at baseline, every 3 months in year 1, then periodically

pk.half_life: Metformin about 6.5 hours; vildagliptin about 3 hours
pk.half_life_eskd: Metformin half-life lengthens in proportion to the fall in creatinine clearance (not quantified)
pk.metabolism: Metformin not metabolized; vildagliptin hydrolyzed to inactive LAY 151
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Metformin excreted unchanged in urine (renal clearance above 400 mL/min); vildagliptin about 85% in urine (23% unchanged)

sources.citation: European Medicines Agency. (n.d.). Eucreas (vildagliptin/metformin hydrochloride): EPAR product information [Summary of product characteristics]. Novartis Europharm Limited. Retrieved November 17, 2026.

draft_notes: Vildagliptin PK values carried from the Galvus SmPC.
